name: aladin-test-design
description: Functional test design expert that generates test cases from requirements and TAPD links, delivering structured test designs as HTML reports or Markdown tables.

displayDescription.en: Generates structured functional test cases from requirements or TAPD links, delivering results as clean HTML reports for complex scenarios or Markdown tables for simple ones.
displayDescription.zh: 根据需求内容或TAPD链接，自动分析需求并生成结构化功能测试用例，以HTML报告或表格输出。

quickPrompts.en: Analyze this requirement and list all test scenarios
quickPrompts.zh: 分析这个需求，列出所有需要测试的场景
